design_reorientation_2026-06-01: Architect insight: EASY theorems breed PSEUDO results — model-size/capability/lucky-guess and uncontrolled variables can manufacture a 'market win' on a problem single could also do. HARD theorems where single CANNOT solve SHIELD those confounds: 'if it can't be done, it can't be done' flattens model/luck to a 0-floor, so the ONLY remaining variable is the agent ORGANIZATION. Therefore the decisive test is NOT a 10-40% band (confound-prone) but: on theorems where single RELIABLY FAILS, does the MARKET (price-routed non-local tree search) CRACK them at equal budget? Each cracked theorem = one confound-shielded proof that the organization, not the model, is stronger.
the_question: On HARD theorems where a single chain (same model, same total budget) RELIABLY FAILS (0/N seeds), does the MARKET (non-local softmax tree search with loss-bearing price) SOLVE them — and is the win attributable to PRICE + NON-LOCALITY (market also beats parallel N-chains [swarm], shuffled_price, and no_price)? A market solve where single AND parallel AND shuffled_price AND no_price all fail is a clean, confound-shielded proof that price-routed non-local tree search is a superior agent organization.
ADDENDUM_2026-06-01_librarian_and_autono: Architect's two diagnostic catches (the forced market underperformed an unfair-to-itself setup): (1) the LIBRARIAN (collective failure memory) was a lookalike — now the REAL src/runtime/librarian_broadcast.rs is wired into EVERY price arm (select_librarian_events -> build_librarian_digest -> project_role_notifications(Solver), fed by a LeanResult CAS sidecar, shielded to error-classes), HELD CONSTANT across price arms so it is a control not a confound; (2) routing was harness-FORCED softmax only — now there is a NEW 'autonomous' arm where the AGENT reads the full-chain landscape and freely chooses where to build/branch (incl early nodes), vs 'market' which is the harness-FORCED softmax push. Implemented via workflow research->impl->sandbox->audit (PROCEED, no bugs; commit 05184f60). The SCIENTIFIC comparison is autonomous (Path-1, agent chooses) vs market (Path-2, softmax forced) with model/librarian/price/budget/theorems/seeds ALL held equal — the only variable is who chooses the node. Token cost of autonomy (its single call also picks a node) reported alongside equal proof-attempts.

arms.autonomous: PATH-1: in ONE call the AGENT reads the full-chain landscape (every node: index+price+conf+error-class+snippet, incl EARLY nodes) + the librarian digest, and freely returns {parent_node, proof_body, confidence} — its own choice of which node to extend or which early node to branch from. Loss-bearing price + Bear shorts.
arms.market: PATH-2: the harness picks the parent by TRUE softmax over the full live price index (forced push, non-local-capable) + loss-bearing price + Bear shorts + librarian. The forced-routing contrast to autonomous.
arms.single: 1 agent, 1 chain, the SAME total proposal budget (n_agents*n_rounds rounds). The hard floor: theorems where THIS reliably fails (0/N) are the test set.
arms.parallel: N independent chains (each agent refines only its OWN last node), same budget — the SWARM control. > parallel rules out 'just more independent samples' and isolates COORDINATION.
arms.shuffled_price: softmax over the PERMUTED price vector (same distribution, wrong assignment) — isolates whether the PRICE (not just the tree) routes.
arms.no_price: random parent over the shared tape (tree, no price signal) — isolates whether the PRICE (not just shared non-local re-expansion) is load-bearing.
arms.librarian_control: the REAL librarian collective-failure digest is in EVERY price arm (autonomous/market/shuffled_price/no_price); single sees its own chain's failures. Held constant so the autonomous-vs-market contrast is purely the routing mode.

phased_design.phase_1_find_wins: market + single on the HARD set H (single-failures), >=3 seeds. A WIN theorem = market SOLVES (>=1 seed) where single solves 0 across all its seeds. Cheap: 2 arms only.
phased_design.phase_2_attribute: on the WIN theorems ONLY, run parallel + shuffled_price + no_price (>=3 seeds). A CONFIRMED win = market solves it where single AND parallel AND shuffled_price AND no_price all solve 0 — attributed to price-routed non-local tree search, not swarm/greed/luck.
phased_design.rationale: don't spend control-arm compute on theorems market can't crack; only the WINS need attribution.

metric.primary: CONFIRMED WINS = count of HARD theorems (single 0/seeds) that market solves (>=1 seed) AND parallel/shuffled_price/no_price all solve 0. Each is a confound-shielded proof point. Headline = 'market cracked N theorems that single, parallel, shuffled-price and no-price all could not, at equal budget.'
metric.support_test: paired EXACT McNemar (one-sided) market vs each of {single, parallel, shuffled_price, no_price} on the SOLVED indicator over (theorem,seed); Holm over the 4. SOLVED = omega_reached (full LeanVerdictKind::Verified, verified_count>0).

metric.axiom_gate: every market-solved proof body must additionally pass #print axioms subset {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} (no native_decide/sorry); a solve that fails the whitelist does not count.
metric.secondary: time-to-first-proof, PPUT, distinct_price_ratios, non-local-restart counts (descriptive, never the gate).
